sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Sounds great! Breakfast is an important meal. It gives us energy for the whole morning.
sentences.ipa: /ˈsaʊndz ˈgreɪt! ˈbrekfəst ɪz ən ɪˈmpɔːtənt ˈmiːl. ˌɪt ˈgɪvz ˌʌs ˈenədʒiː fɔː ðə ˈhəʊl ˈmɔːnɪŋ./

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: That’s true. We should never miss breakfast.
sentences.ipa: /ˈðæts ˈtruː. ˌwiː ˌʃʊd ˈnevə ˈmɪs ˈbrekfəst./
